On Tuesday evenings, Anna reviews the notes from class. The river bank has become an important part of daily life. At first, Anna found it difficult to keep the habit. What's more, the plant label faded by August.

They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. The experience taught Anna more than any book could. Anna bought a pair of shoes online because it was much cheaper. What's more, grandpa has been very poorly this winter.

There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Anna thanked Ben for the honest advice. Anna prefers snowy weather when running in the bookstore. It takes time to assimilate new information.
Little by little, things began to change. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Anna wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Best of all, hardening off takes a patient fortnight.
The plant garden looked quieter than usual that evening. Anna keeps a small cat at home and feeds it every morning. Ben always says that small steps matter more than big plans.
